content:
I just made a fresh project with toolchain 4.29.1 and I can't get mathlib cache. This is not a theoretical issue -- I have some students handing in a project on Monday on 4.29.1 and it's a bit late to start bumping. Here's what I'm getting with a test project:

buzzard@IC-HWDXTW69VR CacheTest % ls
CacheTest       CacheTest.lean      lake-manifest.json  lakefile.toml       lean-toolchain
buzzard@IC-HWDXTW69VR CacheTest % lake clean
buzzard@IC-HWDXTW69VR CacheTest % lake exe cache get
Fetching ProofWidgets cloud release... done!
Current branch: HEAD
Using cache (Azure) from origin: leanprover-community/mathlib4
Attempting to download 8232 file(s) from leanprover-community/mathlib4 cache
Downloaded: 0 file(s) [attempted 1832/8232 = 22%, 1 KB/s], Decompressed: 0^C
buzzard@IC-HWDXTW69VR CacheTest % more lean-toolchain
leanprover/lean4:v4.29.1
buzzard@IC-HWDXTW69VR CacheTest % more lakefile.toml
name = "CacheTest"
version = "0.1.0"
defaultTargets = ["CacheTest"]

[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
scope = "leanprover-community"
rev = "v4.29.1"

[[lean_lib]]
name = "CacheTest"
buzzard@IC-HWDXTW69VR CacheTest %
cc: @Marcelo Lynch who's been cleaning up the cache recently. I think we might have to rebuild the cache for tags that aren't directly reachable from master...
Ah, patches! I'm on it, I'll keep this thread updated.
Actually, it seems that maybe it was never built in the first place: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/actions/runs/25340174508/job/74295219504#step:20:19
I have a 'cache warming' workflow for downstream-reports that should help here
It's running now -- it's a full build due to the toolchain bump so it will take a little bit, I'll post here when it's done
The blobs in the cache have been recovered -- @Kevin Buzzard please try again and let me know if anything looks wrong. Sorry about the disruption!
